# CONTRACT-VALUE-TYPES：Shared Kernel 值对象

## Identifier

- MUST 使用规范小写 UUID 字符串作为内部 ID；无派生身份规范时 V1 生成算法为 UUID4。
- 只有登记在 manifest 的契约可以指定 UUID5 派生身份。V1 Ledger transaction/entry 与 Reconciliation Case 的固定 namespace、canonical name 和算法由 `PORTS-LEDGER-PORTFOLIO` 冻结；实现者不得选择 namespace 或改用 UUID4。
- MUST 在构造时验证格式；相同文本具有值相等和稳定 hash。
- MUST NOT 把数据库自增 ID、Broker ID 或策略名称混作内部 ID。
- Broker/client/trade ID 是独立受限字符串值对象，不假设 UUID。

## InstrumentId

- 是规范化、不透明、区分大小写的字符串，长度 1–64。
- Domain 不解析供应商代码；Reference Data/Gateway 负责供应商代码映射。
- 同一证券只有一个内部 InstrumentId，映射按 trading_day/version 管理。

## Currency

- 使用大写 ISO-4217 三字符代码；首版必须支持 CNY。
- 不同 Currency 的 Money 禁止直接加减或比较大小，除非显式通过版本化 FX Rate 转换。

## Decimal 规则

- 输入只接受 Decimal、int 或规范十进制字符串；MUST NOT 接受 float。
- 禁止 NaN、Infinity、负零和指数形式序列化。
- JSON 使用普通十进制字符串，不丢 trailing semantic scale。
- 中间计算使用局部 Decimal context，不修改进程全局 context。

## Money

- 字段：amount、currency。
- amount 最大 8 位小数；具体记账 scale 由 Currency/BusinessType 配置。
- 会计分录量化使用显式 rounding policy；默认 `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`。
- Money 乘除必须返回明确类型，禁止隐式与 Price 互换。

## Price

- 必须有限且大于零；最多 8 位小数。
- 下单前必须符合 InstrumentSpec.tick_size；Domain 值对象不自行猜测 tick。
- Price×Quantity 的结果是 Money，需要显式 currency 和量化规则。

## Quantity

- 首版证券交易 Quantity 是非负整数；Order quantity 必须大于零。
- 有符号持仓变化使用 PositionDelta，不能用负 Order Quantity。
- lot_size 取整默认向零；不足最小单位产生 NoAction/Dust，而非四舍五入扩大风险。
- 未来支持小数资产时发布新 Quantity 契约版本，不改变 V1 含义。

## Ledger / Portfolio precision

- `CONTRACT-LEDGER-ACCOUNTING-V1`、`CONTRACT-PORTFOLIO-PROJECTION-V1` 和 `CONTRACT-RECONCILIATION-V1` 的金额、价格、费用、税费、成本与 PnL 字段只接受普通十进制字符串，不接受 JSON number/float。
- CNY 最终 Ledger Money 使用 scale 2、最小单位 `0.01` 和 `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`；单位成本保留 scale 8。量化残差必须按规范显式入账，禁止丢弃或改写既有分录。
- V1 Position quantity/available quantity 是非负整数且 `available <= quantity`；负持仓/小数资产必须发布新契约版本。

## Ratio / Weight

- 使用 Decimal；是否允许负数和大于 1 由 Strategy Mandate 决定。
- 普通多头 TargetWeight 默认范围 `[0, 1]`，组合合计和现金 buffer 由 TargetResolver 校验。

## 时间

- Business timestamp 必须是 UTC aware datetime；JSON 使用 ISO-8601 `...Z`。
- TradingDay 是交易日历给出的 `YYYY-MM-DD`，不能由 UTC 日期推断。
- 延迟测量使用 monotonic_ns，不能与业务时间比较。

## Clock Port

```python
class Clock(Protocol):
    def now(self) -> datetime: ...
    def monotonic_ns(self) -> int: ...
```

Domain 禁止直接调用 datetime.now、time.time 或 time.monotonic。LiveClock 与 VirtualClock 必须通过同一契约测试。

## 序列化与日志

- 值对象序列化必须稳定、可往返且与 JSON Schema 一致。
- `str()` 用于规范机器表示；面向用户格式化使用单独 Presenter。
- Secret、账户敏感值不属于 Shared Kernel 通用值对象。

  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "$id": "urn:quantiqmt:contract:strategy-checkpoint:v1",
  "title": "StrategyCheckpointEnvelopeV1",
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": ["checkpoint_id", "strategy_id", "strategy_version", "generation", "schema_version", "captured_at", "payload", "payload_sha256"],
  "properties": {
    "checkpoint_id": {"type": "string", "minLength": 16, "maxLength": 64},
    "strategy_id": {"type": "string", "minLength": 1, "maxLength": 128},
    "strategy_version": {"type": "string", "minLength": 1, "maxLength": 64},
    "generation": {"type": "integer", "minimum": 1},
    "schema_version": {"const": "1.0"},
    "captured_at": {"type": "string", "format": "date-time"},
    "payload": {"type": "object"},
    "payload_sha256": {
      "type": "string", "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{64}$",
      "description": "SHA-256 hex digest of the UTF-8 bytes of the payload serialized with RFC 8785 JSON Canonicalization Scheme (JCS): lexicographically sorted object keys, no insignificant whitespace, UTF-8 without BOM, Unicode emitted as scalar values, and RFC 8785 number serialization. Hash input is exactly the payload value, excluding the envelope and payload_sha256 itself."
    }
  }
}

{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "$id": "urn:quantiqmt:internal:target-resolver:v1",
  "title": "TargetResolverContractsV1",
  "oneOf": [
    {"$ref": "#/$defs/strategyMandate"},
    {"$ref": "#/$defs/instrumentSpec"},
    {"$ref": "#/$defs/resolutionPolicy"},
    {"$ref": "#/$defs/resolutionSnapshot"},
    {"$ref": "#/$defs/resolutionRequest"},
    {"$ref": "#/$defs/resolutionResult"},
    {"$ref": "#/$defs/storedResolutionRecord"},
    {"$ref": "#/$defs/resolutionTriggerReceipt"}
  ],
  "$defs": {
    "uuid": {
      "type": "string",
      "format": "uuid",
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$"
    },
    "identifier": {"type": "string", "minLength": 1, "maxLength": 128},
    "instrumentId": {"type": "string", "minLength": 1, "maxLength": 64},
    "currency": {"type": "string", "pattern": "^[A-Z]{3}$"},
    "timestamp": {
      "type": "string",
      "format": "date-time",
      "pattern": "^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}(\\.[0-9]{1,6})?Z$"
    },
    "hash": {"type": "string", "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{64}$"},
    "decimal": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^(?!-0(?:\\.0+)?$)-?(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,17})(\\.[0-9]{1,8})?$"
    },
    "nonNegativeDecimal": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,17})(\\.[0-9]{1,8})?$"
    },
    "positiveDecimal": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^(?=.*[1-9])(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,17})(\\.[0-9]{1,8})?$"
    },
    "ratio": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^(0(\\.[0-9]{1,8})?|1(\\.0{1,8})?)$"
    },
    "sourceSnapshotRef": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": ["source", "snapshot_version", "checksum", "as_of", "quality", "completeness"],
      "properties": {
        "source": {"$ref": "#/$defs/identifier"},
        "snapshot_version": {"$ref": "#/$defs/identifier"},
        "checksum": {"$ref": "#/$defs/hash"},
        "as_of": {"$ref": "#/$defs/timestamp"},
        "quality": {"enum": ["FRESH", "STALE", "UNAVAILABLE", "UNCERTAIN"]},
        "completeness": {"enum": ["COMPLETE", "PARTIAL"]}
      }
    },
    "strategyMandate": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "dto_type", "schema_version", "mandate_id", "mandate_version", "mandate_checksum",
        "strategy_id", "strategy_version", "scope_type", "scope_id", "account_id",
        "portfolio_id", "allowed_target_types", "allowed_instrument_ids", "long_only",
        "max_target_weight", "max_position_quantity", "cash_buffer_ratio",
        "cash_buffer_absolute", "effective_from", "effective_until"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "dto_type": {"const": "STRATEGY_MANDATE"},
        "schema_version": {"const": 1},
        "mandate_id": {"$ref": "#/$defs/uuid"},
        "mandate_version": {"$ref": "#/$defs/identifier"},
        "mandate_checksum": {"$ref": "#/$defs/hash"},
        "strategy_id": {"$ref": "#/$defs/identifier"},
        "strategy_version": {"type": "string", "minLength": 1, "maxLength": 64},
        "scope_type": {"const": "STRATEGY_SLEEVE"},
        "scope_id": {"$ref": "#/$defs/identifier"},
        "account_id": {"$ref": "#/$defs/identifier"},
        "portfolio_id": {"$ref": "#/$defs/uuid"},
        "allowed_target_types": {
          "type": "array", "items": {"enum": ["WEIGHT", "POSITION"]},
          "minItems": 1, "maxItems": 2, "uniqueItems": true
        },
        "allowed_instrument_ids": {
          "type": "array", "items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/instrumentId"},
          "minItems": 1, "maxItems": 4096, "uniqueItems": true
        },
        "long_only": {"const": true},
        "max_target_weight": {"$ref": "#/$defs/ratio"},
        "max_position_quantity": {"type": "integer", "minimum": 0, "maximum": 9007199254740991},
        "cash_buffer_ratio": {"$ref": "#/$defs/ratio"},
        "cash_buffer_absolute": {"$ref": "#/$defs/nonNegativeDecimal"},
        "effective_from": {"$ref": "#/$defs/timestamp"},
        "effective_until": {"$ref": "#/$defs/timestamp"}
      }
    },
    "instrumentSpec": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "dto_type", "schema_version", "instrument_id", "instrument_spec_version",
        "instrument_spec_checksum", "currency", "quantity_scale", "lot_size",
        "min_order_quantity", "tick_size", "currency_minor_unit", "price_band_source",
        "quantity_rounding", "buy_price_rounding", "sell_price_rounding",
        "sell_to_zero_odd_lot_allowed", "effective_from", "effective_until"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "dto_type": {"const": "INSTRUMENT_SPEC"},
        "schema_version": {"const": 1},
        "instrument_id": {"$ref": "#/$defs/instrumentId"},
        "instrument_spec_version": {"$ref": "#/$defs/identifier"},
        "instrument_spec_checksum": {"$ref": "#/$defs/hash"},
        "currency": {"$ref": "#/$defs/currency"},
        "quantity_scale": {"const": 0},
        "lot_size": {"type": "integer", "minimum": 1, "maximum": 9007199254740991},
        "min_order_quantity": {"type": "integer", "minimum": 1, "maximum": 9007199254740991},
        "tick_size": {"$ref": "#/$defs/positiveDecimal"},
        "currency_minor_unit": {"$ref": "#/$defs/positiveDecimal"},
        "price_band_source": {"const": "MARKET_SNAPSHOT_LIMITS"},
        "quantity_rounding": {"const": "TOWARD_ZERO"},
        "buy_price_rounding": {"const": "FLOOR"},
        "sell_price_rounding": {"const": "CEILING"},
        "sell_to_zero_odd_lot_allowed": {"type": "boolean"},
        "effective_from": {"$ref": "#/$defs/timestamp"},
        "effective_until": {"$ref": "#/$defs/timestamp"}
      }
    },
    "resolutionPolicy": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "dto_type", "schema_version", "resolver_policy_version", "policy_checksum",
        "order_type", "time_in_force", "position_effect", "price_reference_source",
        "quantity_deadband", "notional_deadband", "max_snapshot_age_ms"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "dto_type": {"const": "TARGET_RESOLUTION_POLICY"},
        "schema_version": {"const": 1},
        "resolver_policy_version": {"const": "TARGET_RESOLVER_V1"},
        "policy_checksum": {"$ref": "#/$defs/hash"},
        "order_type": {"const": "LIMIT"},
        "time_in_force": {"const": "DAY"},
        "position_effect": {"const": "AUTO"},
        "price_reference_source": {"const": "MARKET_REFERENCE_PRICE"},
        "quantity_deadband": {"type": "integer", "minimum": 0, "maximum": 9007199254740991},
        "notional_deadband": {"$ref": "#/$defs/nonNegativeDecimal"},
        "max_snapshot_age_ms": {"type": "integer", "minimum": 1, "maximum": 86400000}
      }
    },
    "positionInput": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": ["quantity", "available_quantity"],
      "properties": {
        "quantity": {"type": "integer", "minimum": 0, "maximum": 9007199254740991},
        "available_quantity": {"type": "integer", "minimum": 0, "maximum": 9007199254740991}
      }
    },
    "priceReference": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "source", "price", "currency", "lower_price_limit", "upper_price_limit",
        "observed_at"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "source": {"const": "MARKET_REFERENCE_PRICE"},
        "price": {"$ref": "#/$defs/positiveDecimal"},
        "currency": {"$ref": "#/$defs/currency"},
        "lower_price_limit": {"$ref": "#/$defs/positiveDecimal"},
        "upper_price_limit": {"$ref": "#/$defs/positiveDecimal"},
        "observed_at": {"$ref": "#/$defs/timestamp"}
      }
    },
    "activeOrderEffect": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "order_id", "intent_id", "order_version", "strategy_id", "strategy_version",
        "scope_id", "account_id", "instrument_id", "state", "side", "original_quantity",
        "cumulative_quantity", "position_applied_cumulative_quantity", "leaves_quantity",
        "expected_delta", "effect_basis"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "order_id": {"$ref": "#/$defs/uuid"},
        "intent_id": {"$ref": "#/$defs/uuid"},
        "order_version": {"type": "integer", "minimum": 1, "maximum": 9007199254740991},
        "strategy_id": {"$ref": "#/$defs/identifier"},
        "strategy_version": {"type": "string", "minLength": 1, "maxLength": 64},
        "scope_id": {"$ref": "#/$defs/identifier"},
        "account_id": {"$ref": "#/$defs/identifier"},
        "instrument_id": {"$ref": "#/$defs/instrumentId"},
        "state": {"enum": [
          "REGISTERED", "RISK_PENDING", "APPROVED", "SUBMITTING", "SUBMIT_UNKNOWN",
          "SUBMITTED", "PARTIALLY_FILLED", "CANCEL_PENDING", "CANCEL_UNKNOWN", "SUSPENDED"
        ]},
        "side": {"enum": ["BUY", "SELL"]},
        "original_quantity": {"type": "integer", "minimum": 1, "maximum": 9007199254740991},
        "cumulative_quantity": {"type": "integer", "minimum": 0, "maximum": 9007199254740991},
        "position_applied_cumulative_quantity": {"type": "integer", "minimum": 0, "maximum": 9007199254740991},
        "leaves_quantity": {"type": "integer", "minimum": 1, "maximum": 9007199254740991},
        "expected_delta": {"type": "integer", "minimum": -9007199254740991, "maximum": 9007199254740991, "not": {"const": 0}},
        "effect_basis": {"const": "OMS_LEAVES_CONSERVATIVE_V1"}
      }
    },
    "resolutionSnapshot": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "dto_type", "schema_version", "snapshot_id", "account_id", "portfolio_id",
        "scope_id", "instrument_id", "currency", "portfolio_source", "account_source",
        "market_source", "strategy_sleeve_source", "active_order_source", "total_equity",
        "projected_available_cash", "current_position", "strategy_sleeve", "price_reference",
        "portfolio_trade_watermark", "strategy_sleeve_trade_watermark",
        "active_order_trade_watermark", "account_reserved_orders_snapshot_version",
        "active_order_effects", "captured_at"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "dto_type": {"const": "TARGET_RESOLUTION_SNAPSHOT"},
        "schema_version": {"const": 1},
        "snapshot_id": {"$ref": "#/$defs/uuid"},
        "account_id": {"$ref": "#/$defs/identifier"},
        "portfolio_id": {"$ref": "#/$defs/uuid"},
        "scope_id": {"$ref": "#/$defs/identifier"},
        "instrument_id": {"$ref": "#/$defs/instrumentId"},
        "currency": {"$ref": "#/$defs/currency"},
        "portfolio_source": {"$ref": "#/$defs/sourceSnapshotRef"},
        "account_source": {"$ref": "#/$defs/sourceSnapshotRef"},
        "market_source": {"$ref": "#/$defs/sourceSnapshotRef"},
        "strategy_sleeve_source": {"$ref": "#/$defs/sourceSnapshotRef"},
        "active_order_source": {"$ref": "#/$defs/sourceSnapshotRef"},
        "total_equity": {"$ref": "#/$defs/nonNegativeDecimal"},
        "projected_available_cash": {"$ref": "#/$defs/nonNegativeDecimal"},
        "current_position": {"$ref": "#/$defs/positionInput"},
        "strategy_sleeve": {"$ref": "#/$defs/positionInput"},
        "price_reference": {"$ref": "#/$defs/priceReference"},
        "portfolio_trade_watermark": {"type": "integer", "minimum": 0, "maximum": 9007199254740991},
        "strategy_sleeve_trade_watermark": {"type": "integer", "minimum": 0, "maximum": 9007199254740991},
        "active_order_trade_watermark": {"type": "integer", "minimum": 0, "maximum": 9007199254740991},
        "account_reserved_orders_snapshot_version": {"$ref": "#/$defs/identifier"},
        "active_order_effects": {
          "type": "array", "items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/activeOrderEffect"},
          "maxItems": 1000
        },
        "captured_at": {"$ref": "#/$defs/timestamp"}
      }
    },
    "acceptedTargetRef": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,

    - CONTRACT-MARKET-SESSION-CHANGED-V1
  partition_order: [source_id, first_source_sequence, partition_id]
  partition_rules:
    - first_source_sequence_lte_last_source_sequence
    - min_event_time_lte_max_event_time
    - min_available_at_lte_max_available_at
    - source_sequence_ranges_do_not_overlap
    - every_partition_checksum_matches_exact_bytes
    - manifest_checksum_matches_RFC8785_projection_without_content_checksum
  event_rules:
    - event_time_lte_available_at
    - available_at_equals_first_accepted_envelope_received_at
    - source_sequence_strictly_increases_per_source_except_exact_duplicate
    - same_event_id_same_fingerprints_is_duplicate
    - same_event_id_different_fingerprint_is_integrity_failure
    - event_contract_and_message_type_are_exactly_bound
    - envelope_and_payload_are_validated_before_scheduler_admission
  adjustment:
    modes: [RAW_AS_TRADED, POINT_IN_TIME_ADJUSTED]
    raw_adjusted_and_tradeable_price_mixing: forbidden
    point_in_time_action_effective_before_available_at: forbidden
  gaps:
    forward_fill_missing_tradeable_data: forbidden
    unresolved_gap_action: reject_or_remain_fail_visible

no_lookahead:
  release_guard: historical_event.available_at_lte_virtual_clock.current_at
  request_guard: request.available_at_lte_lte_virtual_clock.current_at
  snapshot_as_of_guard: snapshot.as_of_lte_virtual_clock.current_at
  future_cursor_or_payload_visibility_to_Strategy_or_business_logic: forbidden
  coordinator_release_hint: opaque_cursor_and_next_available_at_only_for_HISTORICAL_RELEASE_wakeup
  future_partition_metadata_as_strategy_input: forbidden
  bar_rules:
    full_OHLCV_visible_before_final_bar_available_at: forbidden
    current_incomplete_bar_close_high_low_or_volume_visibility: forbidden
    NEXT_BAR_OPEN_fill_report_may_be_emitted_only_when_the_final_bar_fact_is_available: true
  correction_rules:
    apply_only_at_recorded_available_at: true
    retroactive_strategy_state_rewrite: forbidden
  violation:
    historical_read_result: REJECTED/FUTURE_DATA_REQUESTED
    run_evidence: REJECTED/FUTURE_DATA_REQUESTED
    continue_with_partial_future_data: forbidden

virtual_clock:
  business_time_source: injected_virtual_clock_only
  latency_time_source: deterministic_elapsed_microseconds_from_start
  wall_clock: forbidden
  ambient_monotonic_clock: forbidden_for_business_outcomes
  start_state: current_at_equals_start_at_and_elapsed_us_zero
  advance:
    target: minimum_next_dispatch_at
    regression: reject_TIME_REGRESSION
    skip_earlier_event: forbidden
    beyond_end: transition_ENDED_without_dispatch
    current_at: start_at_plus_elapsed_us_exactly
  callback_clock_mutation: forbidden

scheduler:
  queue: bounded_and_versioned
  canonical_key: [dispatch_at, priority, source_id_ASCII, source_sequence, causal_sequence, event_id]
  priorities:
    CONTROL: 0
    HISTORICAL_RELEASE: 5
    SESSION: 10
    MARKET_QUALITY: 20
    BROKER_TRADE: 30
    BROKER_ORDER: 40
    MARKET_DATA: 50
    STRATEGY_CALLBACK: 60
    TIMER: 70
    CHECKPOINT: 80
  rules:
    - dto_priority_equals_event_type_priority
    - dispatch_at_within_run_bounds
    - same_idempotency_key_same_payload_is_IDEMPOTENT_REPLAY
    - same_idempotency_key_different_payload_is_REJECTED_INVALID_EVENT
    - repeated_exact_cancel_is_IDEMPOTENT_REPLAY_ALREADY_CANCELED
    - cancel_unknown_event_is_REJECTED_EVENT_NOT_FOUND
    - cancel_dispatched_event_is_REJECTED_EVENT_ALREADY_DISPATCHED
    - newly_scheduled_same_time_event_must_sort_after_current_key
    - causal_sequence_never_references_future_dispatch
    - output_order_independent_of_process_thread_hash_locale_and_insertion_race
  overflow: reject_QUEUE_CAPACITY_EXCEEDED_without_drop_or_reorder
  misfire_policy: deterministic_fail_closed_no_wall_clock_catchup

historical_market_port:
  read_result: exhaustive_PAGE_WAIT_END_REJECTED
  page:
    every_item_available_at_lte_request_bound: true
    every_item_available_at_lte_virtual_clock: true
    canonical_order: [available_at, source_id, source_sequence, event_id]
    next_cursor: opaque_stable_and_manifest_bound
    next_available_at: null
  wait:
    reason: NOT_YET_AVAILABLE
    items: empty
    next_cursor: opaque_stable_and_manifest_bound
    next_available_at: earliest_unreleased_recorded_available_at_strictly_after_virtual_clock
    next_available_at_lte_run_end_at: mandatory
    visibility: coordinator_only_never_Strategy_or_business_logic
    only_allowed_use: schedule_HISTORICAL_RELEASE_wakeup_at_next_available_at
    payload_price_volume_or_future_partition_content: forbidden
    wakeup:
      event_type: HISTORICAL_RELEASE
      priority: 5
      contract_id: CONTRACT-BACKTEST-PARITY-V1
      source_id: HISTORICAL_MARKET
      source_sequence: 0
      dispatch_at: next_available_at
      payload_projection: [run_id, manifest_checksum, next_cursor, next_available_at]
      payload_checksum: SHA256(JCS(payload_projection))
      idempotency_key: 'concat("history-release:",payload_checksum)'
      duplicate_hint: exact_scheduler_IDEMPOTENT_REPLAY
  end:
    shape: empty_items_null_cursor_and_null_next_available_at
    reasons: [END_OF_DATA, END_OF_RUN_RANGE]
    earliest_unreleased_available_at_after_run_end: END_OF_RUN_RANGE
  rejected: empty_items_and_null_cursor
  routine_exception_escape: forbidden
  checkout_spec_access: forbidden

execution_simulation:
  gateway_contract: CONTRACT-EXECUTION-BROKER-GATEWAY-V1
  scenario_contract: CONTRACT-BROKER-SCENARIO-V1
  output_contracts: [CONTRACT-BROKER-TRADE-V1, CONTRACT-BROKER-ORDER-REPORTED-V1]
  oms_state_mutation: forbidden
  broker_side_effect: simulated_only
  accepted_order_cutoff: scheduler_key_of_confirmed_submit
  scenario_profile:
    gateway_lifecycle_and_fault_authority: CONTRACT-BROKER-SCENARIO-V1
    market_fill_price_quantity_authority: execution_policy_and_released_market_fact_only
    forbidden_scenario_fill_actions: [PARTIAL_FILL, FULL_FILL, CANCEL_RACE]
    DUPLICATE_or_OUT_OF_ORDER: may_reference_only_already_generated_report_groups_without_changing_identity_or_payload
    undeclared_or_exhausted_action: fail_closed_before_implicit_success
  matching:
    eligible_market_fact: scheduler_key_strictly_after_accepted_order_cutoff
    eligible_business_time: candidate_trade_time_strictly_after_order_accepted_at
    models:
      NEXT_TICK_V1:
        base_price: next_released_tradeable_tick_price
        quantity_source: next_released_incremental_tick_quantity
      NEXT_BAR_OPEN_V1:
        base_price: next_final_bar_open
        quantity_source: final_bar_volume_available_only_at_bar_release
        trade_time: bar_open
        received_at: final_bar_available_at_plus_fill_report_latency
    session_state: OPEN_only
    suspended_untradeable_gap_or_non_NORMAL_quality: no_fill_and_fail_visible
    max_participation_rate: greater_than_zero_and_lte_one
    fill_quantity: floor(released_incremental_volume*max_participation_rate)_bounded_by_leaves
    partial_fill_disabled_and_liquidity_below_leaves: no_fill
    competing_order_priority: [accepted_scheduler_key, order_id_ASCII]
    released_incremental_volume_budget: decrement_once_in_competing_order_priority_and_never_reuse
    limit_buy: adjusted_fill_price_lte_limit_price
    limit_sell: adjusted_fill_price_gte_limit_price
    market_order: accepted_only_when_capability_and_price_band_allow
    time_in_force:
      DAY: remain_eligible_until_terminal_or_session_close_then_emit_EXPIRED
      IOC: evaluate_first_eligible_released_fact_once_fill_available_quantity_then_cancel_leaves
      FOK: fill_full_leaves_on_first_eligible_released_fact_or_cancel_without_trade
      unsupported_or_ambiguous: reject_before_side_effect
    cancellation_race:
      authority: admitted_canonical_scheduler_order
      confirmed_cancel_prevents_new_match: true
      already_admitted_trade_or_report_rewrite: forbidden
      final_state_resolution: OMS_only_from_existing_Broker_reports
  slippage:
    NONE: value_must_equal_zero
    FIXED_BPS: base_price_times_value_div_10000
    FIXED_TICKS: tick_size_times_value
    direction: BUY_adds_and_SELL_subtracts
    tick_rounding: BUY_ceiling_and_SELL_floor
    positive_and_inside_inclusive_price_band: mandatory
    clamp_to_limit_or_price_band: forbidden
  fees:
    notional: exact_fill_price_times_integer_quantity
    commission_accrual: PER_ORDER_CUMULATIVE_DELTA_V1
    cumulative_required_commission: max(minimum_commission,cumulative_filled_notional_times_commission_rate)
    fill_commission: cumulative_required_commission_minus_prior_commission_charged
    transfer_fee: notional_times_transfer_fee_rate
    tax: SELL_only_notional_times_sell_tax_rate
    rounding: each_component_independently_to_currency_minor_unit_HALF_EVEN
    negative_or_float: forbidden
    trade_report_binding:
      commission: rounded_commission
      fee.amount: rounded_transfer_fee
      fee.currency: policy_currency
      fee.rounding_policy_version: CURRENCY_MINOR_UNIT_HALF_EVEN_V1
      tax: rounded_tax
  fill_emission_order: [broker_trade_reported, broker_order_reported]
  latency:
    source: immutable_nonnegative_integer_microseconds
    randomness: forbidden
    dispatch_order: scheduler_canonical_key
    gateway_deadline_comparison: VirtualClock_only_never_host_clock
    causal_report_after_run_end: fail_END_BOUNDARY_UNSETTLED_without_COMPLETED_claim
  unknown_outcome:
    source: explicit_scenario_action_only
    action: preserve_same_identity_and_reconcile
    blind_retry: forbidden

shared_architecture:
  shared_between_live_and_backtest:
    - Domain_models_and_state_machines
    - Application_use_cases
    - Strategy_artifact_and_parameters
    - TargetResolver
    - Risk_rules
    - OMS_registration_and_transition_chain
    - Ledger_and_Portfolio_logic
    - Message_and_internal_contract_bundle
  replaceable_adapters_only:
    - Clock
    - Market
    - Execution
    - Scheduler
    - Storage
  forbidden_backtest_shortcuts:

    - direct_OMS_state_mutation
    - bypass_Risk
    - direct_Ledger_or_Portfolio_overwrite
    - special_backtest_only_strategy_branch
    - implicit_successful_execution

parity:
  scopes:
    SHARED_LOGIC:
      compare:
        - strategy_callback_input_fingerprints
        - strategy_Target_or_OrderIntent_payloads
        - TargetResolver_results
        - Risk_decisions
        - OMS_business_transitions
      adapter_outcomes_equal: not_claimed
    RECORDED_TRACE_REPLAY:
      compare:
        - normalized_accepted_inputs
        - normalized_business_outputs
        - causal_order
        - final_Ledger_and_Portfolio_checksums
      recorded_external_facts: replayed_at_their_recorded_available_at
  normalization_excludes:
    - host_process_identity
    - wall_clock_duration
    - transport_connection_identity
    - adapter_telemetry
  normalization_preserves:
    - message_and_business_identity
    - correlation_and_causation
    - business_and_available_times
    - Decimal_strings
    - outcome_reason_and_error_codes
    - state_versions_and_checksums
  MATCH_requires:
    - normalized_live_checksum_equals_normalized_backtest_checksum
    - mismatch_count_equals_zero
    - future_read_count_equals_zero
    - shared_logic_checksum_matches
  backtest_result_is_production_approval: false

reproducibility:
  evidence_projection:
    - run_id
    - input_fingerprint
    - status
    - reason_code
    - started_at
    - ended_at
    - event_count
    - last_scheduler_key
    - event_journal_checksum
    - strategy_output_checksum
    - broker_report_checksum
    - ledger_checksum
    - portfolio_checksum
    - metrics_checksum
  completed_requires_all_artifact_checksums: true
  append_only_event_journal: true
  repeated_exact_input:
    run_id: identical
    event_order: identical
    broker_reports: byte_identical
    strategy_outputs: byte_identical
    final_checksums: identical
  failed_or_rejected_run:
    evidence_still_persisted: true
    claim_partial_result_as_completed: forbidden
  run_end_boundary:
    external_fact_admission: available_at_lte_end_at
    required_causal_output_dispatch_after_end_at: FAILED_END_BOUNDARY_UNSETTLED
    silent_truncation_or_COMPLETED_with_pending_order_timer_or_report: forbidden

observability:
  required_log_fields: [run_id, input_fingerprint, virtual_time, scheduler_key, event_type, outcome, reason_code, contract_version]
  required_metrics: [events_total, virtual_time_advanced_us, scheduler_queue_depth, future_read_rejections_total, fills_total, rejected_matches_total, parity_mismatches_total]
  forbidden_metric_labels: [run_id, event_id, order_id, trade_id, instrument_id, account_id, checksum]
  wall_time_performance_measurement: telemetry_only_not_business_input

rollback:
  before_runtime_adoption: revert_additive_internal_contract_bundle
  after_artifact_creation:
    - stop_new_runs_before_readers
    - preserve_run_specs_event_journals_and_evidence
    - never_relabel_failed_or_mismatched_run_as_completed

  release: prohibited
